safety_goal.formula: guarantee(RTA_FCC_A:BOUNDED_COMMAND_OUTPUT) AND guarantee(SR_FCC:CONTINUOUS_COMMAND_OUTPUT) AND guarantee(PSC_ACU:PROTECTED_COMMAND_OUTPUT) AND refines(RTA_FCC_A, SR_FCC.primaryChannel) AND compatible_boundary(SR_FCC.output, PSC_ACU.input) IMPLIES protected_actuator_command

LossOfActuatorCommand.expression: ((F_FCCA_LOF and (F_FCCB_LOF or F_fd_miss or F_sw_fail)) or F_dp_perm or (F_dp_trans and F_recover_fail))

HazardousActuatorCommand.expression: ((F_adv_vio and (F_mon_miss or F_safe_fail or F_sel_fail)) or (F_dp_err and F_am_miss))

safety_goal.formula: guarantee(MN_Sensor:VOTED_PARAMETER_OUTPUT) AND guarantee(CC_Nav:CHECKED_PARAMETER_OUTPUT) AND guarantee(IM_Display_L:GUARDED_DISPLAY_OUTPUT) AND guarantee(IM_Display_R:GUARDED_DISPLAY_OUTPUT) AND compatible_boundary(MN_Sensor.output, CC_Nav.input) AND compatible_boundary(CC_Nav.output, IM_Display_L.input) AND compatible_boundary(CC_Nav.output, IM_Display_R.input) AND independent_resources(IM_Display_L, IM_Display_R, ['PWR', 'CPU', 'CLK']) IMPLIES dual_guarded_parameter_display

HazardousParameterDisplayed.expression: ((((F_s1_err and F_s2_err) or (F_s1_err and F_s3_err) or (F_s2_err and F_s3_err) or F_voter_err or (F_nav_diff and F_cmp_miss)) and F_im_l_miss) or (((F_s1_err and F_s2_err) or (F_s1_err and F_s3_err) or (F_s2_err and F_s3_err) or F_voter_err or (F_nav_diff and F_cmp_miss)) and F_im_r_miss))

LossOfTrustedParameterDisplay.expression: ((F_mn_output_loss or F_cc_output_loss or F_im_l_unavailable) and (F_mn_output_loss or F_cc_output_loss or F_im_r_unavailable))
